name: Zul'Gurub: Mandokir's Decapitate and Mortal Strike cannot be dodged or parried
contract: In the live logs Mandokir's (11382) Decapitate (2118410) landed 12 of 12 and the hit of his Mortal Strike
(2118402) about 123 of 123, with no dodge, parry or miss, while the same tanks dodged about 45 % of his
swings. The DBC flags neither spell as unavoidable, so the server rolled dodge and parry for both. The hero
faces a level-63 attacker and carries Evasion (5277). The native melee spell roll is sampled 512 times: an
ordinary melee spell (Heroic Strike, 78) is dodged or parried, while Decapitate and Mortal Strike never are.

steps.label: CONTROL: Evasion gives the hero a high dodge chance
CONTROL: an ordinary melee spell is dodged or parried
DISCRIMINATING: Decapitate is never dodged or parried
DISCRIMINATING: Mortal Strike is never dodged or parried
